## proof

Modulo a prime $p$, pair each residue with its inverse. Only $1$ and $p - 1$ are their own inverses, so the product is $-1$. If $n$ is composite, a proper factor of $n$ divides $(n-1)!$, so $(n-1)! \not\equiv -1$.
